posts.text: Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.

Went through the Kessa–North highway announcement again. Fine to celebrate a road. But 'prosperity for every family' needs numbers behind it. What's the cost, who pays, and what did the inflation figures look like last year? Asking honestly, as someone who taught this for 30 years.
Highway opening on VBC tonight. Nice ribbon. Still waiting for the part where a Kessa–North commuter can afford the toll. Arden's costings question was the one worth watching in that debate.
Watched the Kito debate. Ostrand kept saying 'inflation fell'. Ask my fuel bill and my fertiliser bill how that went. Arden at least named a number. Who's actually costing this?

Watched the Kito debate tonight. Ostrand kept saying 'inflation fell' but my grocery bill says otherwise. Arden at least gave numbers on jobs. Both need to show the math. Nurses are still short-staffed either way.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? My tractor diesel bill says the number's not made up. Who's paying for the new roads when the bill comes due?
Saw that the Unity Party page claims Arden's plan doubles food VAT. Before sharing, check the actual plan document and the VAT figures yourself. Measure twice, cut once, as they say.

Fact-check day 2: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But it also estimates a gap of about 2% of GDP. Read the actual numbers and check both sides before you decide. Source links in the thread.
Two weeks to go and I've now heard the Kessa-North highway ribbon-cutting described as both 'prosperity' and 'a detour'. Mara, the roads are nice. Now show me the toll math. #VeloriaVotes

Fact-checkers cleared the 'double VAT' claim, but the same note says the Civic Front plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Before we celebrate any costing, let's ask the same hard questions of both sides. Show the numbers, all of them.

Ostrand cut a ribbon, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the moderators asked BOTH how they'd pay for it. Only one of them looked like they'd been waiting for that question. Still undecided. Still running on cold coffee.

Read the VeriCheck breakdown on the Arden plan. Doubled VAT: false. The 40% fuel number: picked from a peak month. Still a 2% of GDP gap by economists' estimates. Everyone should check the numbers before voting, both sides.

Still thinking about the Kito debate. Ostrand's 'inflation fell' doesn't match my grocery receipts. Arden gave jobs numbers, but who's costing the nursing shortage? Both should show the full math before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3, 10 to go. Forwarded audio of Arden saying 'our agents will handle the rest' is going round my WhatsApp. VBC says it's questionable, Civic Front says it's fake. Nobody's checked it yet. Don't share till someone has. #VeloriaVotes

VBC just aired a 'questions raised' segment on a recording allegedly of Arden, played in full. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Cool. Who made it, who had it first, and where's the chain of custody? Not voting on a clip I can't verify, but I want the actual answers before I decide.

Day 3 check: VBC is airing a recording 'said to feature' Mr Arden and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing clips, ask: who supplied it, when was it made, and has anyone run an audio/provenance check? Wait for independent verification. Source links in thread.

Two forwards today: a 'leaked audio' of Mr Arden begging everyone to share before it's deleted, and VBC saying 'questions raised' about a recording it says is his, while his side says it's fake. Before I forward or repeat anything, I want to hear it verified by someone with no stake in this. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded audio. 'We will pay the commission and our agents will handle the rest.' Before anyone shares it: Civic Front says it's an AI fake, VBC says 'questions raised', nobody's verified it. Wait for the forensic check before you pass it on. My trust in ANY of these clips is at zero right now.

Watched the VBC clip on the 'questions raised' recording twice. A recording with no verified chain of custody isn't evidence of anything yet. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Let's wait for independent forensic checks before drawing conclusions, and hold both sides to the same standard.
Forwarded audio is everywhere and I'm not sharing it. Two weeks out and I still can't verify a single clip. Both camps: show the costings, not the rumours. Staff shortages are real either way.

Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a coin toss with a tie inside it. Whoever wins, I want the costings checked by someone neutral, not just shouted at me by either side. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 to go. Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. So basically a coin flip with a 10% pile of people like me who still don't know. Running mate passport story from Patriots Daily also dropped today. Can we get the facts on that before everyone picks a side? Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check: Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and plans to sell the port. Before sharing, look for the source: which document, which registry, and has anyone confirmed it? Mistakes spread faster than corrections. Links in thread once I find them.

Day 4, 9 to go. Kito poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, and that's inside the margin. So it's still a coin toss. Mara, Tomas, both of you: show me the toll math on the Kessa road. #VeloriaVotes

Read both today's stories closely. A leaked-documents claim against the ministry and a poll with a ±3 margin. Neither is settled yet. The poll is a 2-point gap inside the error bars, so 'leading' is the wrong word. Let's wait for the document checks and hold both sides to the same bar.

Kito poll out: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Before we all decide, can both camps show the full costings? My ward is still short-staffed no matter who wins. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Ledger says a deputy finance minister's relative got road contracts. Ministry says fabricated. Both can't be the whole story yet. Who has the documents, and has anyone seen them besides the paper? Checking before I have an opinion.

Kito poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Inside the margin, so nobody gets to say they're ahead. Still not telling anyone how to vote. What I want from both: the fuel and fertiliser numbers, in writing, before the 9 days are up.

Day 5, 8 to go. Saw the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing: 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity, sign up via bot link. Pay per vote? That's not a job, that's a bounty. Before anyone signs up, check who's paying. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 check: IEC published its results-transmission procedure. Forms are scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good to see. Anyone who wants to check the tally can do it there, not just take anyone's word. Link in thread.

Day 5, 8 to go. Two hashtags trending, both from accounts made this month posting the same text within minutes. Coordinated, obviously. Which side paid for it? Not telling anyone who to vote for until I know who's actually talking. Cold coffee, still undecided.

Day 5, 8 to go. Poll says 46-44, inside the margin, so it's a coin toss. I still want the fuel and fertiliser numbers in writing from both sides before I believe either one. Show me the bill math, not the slogans.

Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Anyone going? Would like to see it before I trust a count either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. A 2,000 vel 'ambassador' sign-up that pays 5,000 more if your polling station votes Unity? That's not a volunteer job, that's a bribe with a bot link. Don't tap it. And the commission's results portal is public, so check the real thing before you trust any screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. That's a dead heat inside the error bars, so 'leading' is the wrong word for either. Before anyone celebrates a 2-point gap, let's see the costings from both campaigns checked by someone neutral. Numbers first, cheers after.

Day 6, 7 to go. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER': 212 Northern polling stations moving 'for security'. Before you go, check the IEC site or call your local office. Don't trust a WhatsApp PDF. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Ostrand 'slip of the tongue' clip is everywhere and her team's already spun it. Mispronouncing a town name is not a policy. Can we talk about the Kessa road tolls or the fuel numbers instead? Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito's clip of the president mangling a provincial town's name is funny, but it tells us nothing about her costings. Forgive the flub, then ask both teams for the same thing: the full fiscal table, with the assumptions written out. Numbers first.

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito clip of the president mispronouncing a provincial town is going round. Her team says slip of the tongue. Fine, but that's not a policy question. Let's keep the 7 days for costings and documents. Who has the Kessa road numbers in writing? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Forwarded WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels, check the IEC site or call your local office. Verify first, then go. Ward's still short-staffed either way. #VeloriaVotes

Kito clip of Ostrand mangling the town name. Funny, sure. But one slip isn't a costing. Day 6, 7 to go: if we're talking about her economic record, let's talk about the numbers, not the pronunciation. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A WhatsApp 'official letter' says 212 polling stations are moving over 'security concerns'. Letterhead isn't proof. Before I believe it or share it: check the IEC site and VeloResults. Who sent it first? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 for me, 8 to go. Forwarded 'polling stations moving' letter in my WhatsApp, 212 of them in the North. Before I tell my cousins up there anything: check with the IEC directly, not the forward. Same rule for the Arden 'deleted soon' audio. Who made it? Cold coffee, still driving, still undecided.

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls open, I'd like everyone to do one thing: check the official VeloResults portal rather than any screenshot. Numbers first, cheers after. Whoever you vote for, verify the claims you're about to repeat. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Reminder from the IEC: no campaigning until polls close. Results forms go to VeloResults, so check the tally there, not in forwards. Quiet week, quiet timeline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, and I'm honestly relieved. Every WhatsApp forward is a new 'OFFICIAL' thing. Before you share anything this week, check the IEC site or ring your local office. Still undecided, still short-staffed on my ward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, 6 to go, and campaign silence starts tonight. A voice note telling us to stay home tomorrow because 'we have it covered'? Stay home, nothing. Vote. Check the IEC site for your polling station, not the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, 7 to go... wait no, campaign silence starts tonight so nobody's allowed to campaign now. Just a reminder: a singer's endorsement is still an endorsement, and a viral clip isn't a costing. Check the IEC site before you believe any forward. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Before anyone reposts the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note: who sent it, and does it match what the IEC actually published? Check VeloResults, not the forward. Cold coffee, still undecided.

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Go look at the Commission's VeloResults portal before you trust any count or screenshot anyone sends you, from either side. Boring advice, but it's the only way I know to check a number myself. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from me. Got the Arden voice note forwarded 5 times saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Staying home is a choice you make, not a message you forward. Vote, or don't, but don't let a voice note decide for you. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high. The IEC says the printed register is valid if ID kits fail, so if you're in the North, go anyway. Check your station on the official IEC site, not a forward. Results go to VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, ELECTION DAY. Polls are open. Got a WhatsApp clip of 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' in a Coast school? Don't share it. Check the IEC and VeloResults first. Northern kits failed, so they switched to the printed register like the law says. Go vote, and check your station on the official site. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and my feed is already a mess of 'official' forwards. Rule of the day: check the IEC site or VeloResults before you share anything, from any side. Boring, but it's the only thing that works. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are open. Before you share ANY photo of ballot boxes or 'stay home' voice note today, check the IEC site for your polling station. Printed register is legal if the ID kits fail. Vote, and verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the North, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check your polling station on the IEC site, not a forward. Results go to VeloResults, so check the tally there. Numbers first, cheers after. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the Commission says the printed register is being used where ID kits failed, which is allowed. Before you believe any 'polling stations closed' forward, check the IEC site. Results go to VeloResults, so check the tally there. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls open, I'm going to vote. If your polling station's kit fails, check the IEC site before you believe any forward saying your station moved. Results go to VeloResults, check there. Cold coffee, still undecided.

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high from where I'm standing. Northern kits failing and switching to the printed register is in the rules, so check your name there. The 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is going round again, no source. Check VeloResults for the real tally, not the forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies on Kito and VBC with different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Results go to VeloResults; wait for the Commission's count before anyone calls a winner. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some blue-tick-ish account is 'FINAL RESULTS' at 54-43 already. Three numbers, three sources, zero of them the VeloResults portal. Lol. Refresh the official tally before you quote anyone. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'tallies' from Kito and VBC, each counting different stations first, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' from an account nobody can verify. None of those are results. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC. Still tired, still short-staffed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito and VBC, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by 4 points in opposite directions. Different stations counted first. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults, not a TV tally. Numbers first, cheers after.

Day 9, 5 to go. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally means much yet. Wait for VeloResults, not a screenshot. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and @IECV_Results says 54.2 with a 'thank you Veloria'. Three numbers, zero sources I can open. Results are supposed to be on VeloResults. I'm going there, not reposting any of these. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'results' in my feed. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. I'll wait for the VeloResults forms before I believe a number from either side. Show me the tally, not the claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults. Still undecided, still driving, still cold coffee. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults numbers past 41% of forms, and the IEC calls it a technical glitch. Until the Commission publishes the full tally, I'm not quoting any county or national figure, mine included. Ostrand's fiscal table and Arden's costings should both be checked line by line. Numbers first.

Day 10. VeloResults still only has ~41% of forms up, the Patriots Daily 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' page is citing a portal that's apparently offline, and I have no idea what's real. Refreshing the IEC site like it owes me money. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no province-level winner anywhere official. The VeloResults portal has forms from 41% of stations, and the Commission says the upload delay is a glitch. Patriots Daily's '9 of 14' claim is false per VeriCheck. Wait for the full count from the IEC before believing any province. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9, still no VeloResults numbers for my province. Kito 51, VBC 53, a 'FINAL' screenshot at 54-43. Nobody's showing the forms. Show me the tally, not the claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, still no VeloResults numbers in the thread that matter. The IEC says 41% of forms are up. Three 'official' tallies, none I can open. Not reposting any of them until the portal shows the same number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito says 51, VBC says 53, some account says FINAL 54-43. None of them are VeloResults. Only 41% of forms are online anyway. Wait for the Commission's count before believing any number, from any side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still no VeloResults upload for most stations and the 41% figure hasn't moved. Every number in my feed is from a source I can't open. Going to wait for the official forms and keep driving. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked. Both can't be proven from my kitchen table. Show me the forms on VeloResults, all of them, and I'll believe whichever way they point. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission has declared the result: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but the broadcaster was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Check the IEC page and the observer statement, not the forwards. Still cold coffee. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. First official number all week. Still want to see the VeloResults forms match before I call it settled, but okay, we finally have a count. Cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. That's the official line, so I'll take it as a result. Congrats to the winner, and to everyone who showed up. Now back to the taxi rank. Cold coffee, still driving. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so I'll take it. Congrats to the winner, and to the losing side, sleep well. Cold coffee, finally settled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Tired, short-staffed, and I'd like to hear what the Civic Front and Unity folks plan for the ward budget now. Check VeloResults, not the forwards. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, 68% turnout. Results are on VeloResults, so I'm checking the official tally there before I say anything about the margin or the economy. #VeloriaVotes

Results are declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which deserve scrutiny whoever won. Numbers first. Before we argue about what it means, let's read the Commission's full forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are showing completely different pictures of Kessa. Burning tyres on one, a court petition on the other. Nobody's showing the polling station forms yet. Can we get the VeloResults uploads for the Kessa stations before we decide what happened? Cold coffee, still annoyed.

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is in and the court wants both sides looking at the servers and logs. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it riots. Valdoria Today says the whole thing is a cover-up. Three stories, same day. I'll read the court order, not the headlines. Cold coffee, still driving. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC's 'riots in Kessa' clip, and the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. The court step matters more than either headline. Let's see what the audit finds before anyone calls it. Check the court order itself, not the reactions. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition, VBC shows burning tyres and 'calm restored'. The Court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let them check. Still cold coffee, still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and the Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's the process working. Whatever the logs show, we should read them, not the riot footage on VBC. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are now both carrying the Kessa footage and the court order, and neither says which one is verified. The Commission's declared count is 50.6 to 47.9. If the server access is real, it'll show up in the audit, not in a clip. Checking the IEC page before I share anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Read the Kito piece about the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Whatever the outcome, that's a proper check and I'm glad it's happening. The VBC riot footage needs context before I believe it. Still short-staffed, still tired. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Court is making the Commission open its servers and logs to both sides. That's what I wanted all along: show the forms, let people check them. Whatever the logs say, I'll read them, not the screenshots. Cold coffee, still steady. #VeloriaVotes
